purpose: Astra selects and evaluates an eligible US-listed liquid stock and may propose a long intraday entry only when it estimates positive expected return after costs; otherwise abstain.
universe: Dynamic market-wide Webull US_STOCK top-active set; deterministic price, volume, market-cap, common-stock, tradability, freshness and spread filters; Astra receives up to 10 eligible candidates
entry: LIMIT DAY CORE; whole shares on the observed cent grid
targets: Optional single full-position target; no partial allocation or OCO in MVP
conditions: Current bid/ask/spread predicates only; no persistence or arbitrary code
cost_basis: Observed prior one-share round trip had $0.02 sell fees and $0.01 price loss; not a production fee schedule
